environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed inside a minimal OCI container where the entrypoint invokes the JVM after calling pivot_root into /srv/jail. The jail directory tree contains only: /srv/jail/app/service.jar, /srv/jail/app/config/default.json (empty JSON), /srv/jail/tmp (empty, writable), and the JRE runtime files. The container spec sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with only /srv/jail/tmp mounted as a writable tmpfs. The container runs with a seccomp profile that additionally blocks open_by_handle_at and mount syscalls. Process runs as uid 65534 (nobody) with no supplementary groups. There are no symlinks in the jail tree and /proc is mounted with hidepid=2.

config.runtime: Eclipse Temurin JRE 17-alpine in distroless-like container
config.network: ClusterIP service behind Envoy sidecar with RBAC
